title: Misinformation — groundedness & citations
summary: LLM09. The agent states a refund policy that exists in no source, in the same confident voice as the true answer. Enforce groundedness: every claim must be supported by a retrieved source, or it doesn't ship.
takeaway: You can't verify truth, but you can verify support. Unsupported claims don't ship; supported ones carry citations.
design_rule: Check every claim against the retrieved sources; withhold unsupported claims and cite the rest.
